test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: How many meaningful four-letter English words can be formed using the second, third, fifth and seventh letters of the word TOURIST (when counted from left to right) using each letter only once in each word.
solution:
The second, third, fifth and seventh letters of the word TOURIST are **"O, U, I, T'**.

→ Here, we can see that no word can be formed using these letters. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"None"**.
